acp-quick-connect.title: {{tool}} quick connection
acp-quick-connect.intro: Connect local {{tool}} and choose the model for development tasks.
acp-quick-connect.choose_installation: Choose a native entry with an observed version
acp-quick-connect.no_installations: No selectable native installation is available. Inspect this computer or use the supported official native installation method.
acp-quick-connect.state_idle: Choose a native installation, then explicitly read its model catalogue once.
acp-quick-connect.state_reading: This observation is being read. Wait for its result.
acp-quick-connect.state_ready: The model catalogue was read. Explicitly choose the model for this connection.
acp-quick-connect.state_unsupported: This entry did not provide a supported model catalogue.
acp-quick-connect.state_failed: The model catalogue could not be read. There is no automatic retry; you can explicitly read it again.
acp-quick-connect.state_unknown: This observation's result is unconfirmed. Check only the original observation.
acp-quick-connect.state_expired: This observation has expired. Read the model catalogue again.
acp-quick-connect.state_source_changed: The current source no longer matches the model observation. Read it again.
acp-quick-connect.state_unverified: The observation's expiry is unverified. It cannot be adopted yet.
acp-quick-connect.state_invalid_catalogu: The model catalogue structure could not be verified. It cannot be adopted yet.
acp-quick-connect.state_empty: This catalogue contains no selectable models.
acp-quick-connect.current_unverified: Not provided or absent from this catalogue
acp-quick-connect.selection_boundary: Catalogue options do not establish valid login, model health, pricing or the provider's underlying model. Connection and actual inventory still need verification after selection.
acp-quick-connect.probe_notice: Reading models opens a tool session and may access the network.
acp-quick-connect.storage_failed: This observation request could not be saved. Model reading has not started.
acp-quick-connect.original_unavailable: The original observation cannot be verified. Actions are paused; keep the record and retry checking.
acp-quick-connect.invalid_observation: The tool observation does not match the current source and cannot be adopted.
acp-quick-connect.observation_failed: The tool observation could not be read. Check the current installation or the original observation.
acp-quick-connect.access_changed: The current identity or local source is unavailable. Check your current project access.
acp-quick-connect.credential_hint: Enter only a local environment variable name, never a secret; leave blank to use the existing CLI login.
acp-quick-connect.cursor_credential_hint: Enter the local environment variable name containing your Cursor API key, never its value. It is required before reading models; existing CLI logins or other tools' credentials are not used.
acp-quick-connect.draft_not_connected: The current selection is not connected. You can still check or stop the original connection.
